inputs.content: What's the TDP of the Ryzen 7 7800X3D, the launch price of the Core i7-13700K, and the sensor size of the Sony A7R V?
The Ryzen 7 7800X3D has a 120 W TDP. The Core i7-13700K launched at $409. The Sony A7R V uses a 61.0 MP full-frame (35.7 × 23.8 mm) CMOS sensor.
What's the TDP of the Ryzen 9 7950X, the launch price of the Core i9-13900K, and the sensor size of the Nikon Z9?
The Ryzen 9 7950X has a 170 W TDP. The Nikon Z9 uses a 45.7 MP stacked full-frame (35.9 × 23.9 mm) CMOS sensor.
Tell me the ISA extension for Apple's M2 Max, the TDP for Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, and the launch price for Google Tensor G2.

Apple's M2 Max implements ARMv8.6-A with proprietary extensions. The Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 has a ~5.5 W typical TDP in phone configs. The Google Tensor G2 debuted in the Pixel 7 series at $599/$899 phone pricing — no standalone SoC price published.
Tell me the ISA extension for MediaTek Dimensity 9200, the TDP for Apple A16 Bionic, and the launch price for Samsung Exynos 2200.
The Dimensity 9200 implements ARMv9-A with SVE2. The Exynos 2200 was never sold standalone; it shipped in the Galaxy S22 series priced from $799.
What's the sensor size of the Canon R5, the launch price of the Fuji X-H2S, and the TDP of the RTX 4090?
The Canon EOS R5 has a 45 MP full-frame (36 × 24 mm) CMOS sensor. The Fujifilm X-H2S launched at $2,499 body-only. The GeForce RTX 4090 has a 450 W TDP.
What's the sensor size of the Sony A1, the launch price of the Nikon Z8, and the TDP of the RX 7900 XTX?
The Sony A1 uses a 50.1 MP full-frame (35.9 × 24.0 mm) stacked CMOS. The Radeon RX 7900 XTX has a 355 W TDP.
ISA extension for Ryzen 7000 series, TDP for Core Ultra 7 155H, launch price for Arc A770 16GB.

Ryzen 7000 supports AVX-512 via AVX-512F, CD, BW, DQ, VL, IFMA, VBMI, BF16, VPOPCNTDQ, BITALG, VNNI, VP2INTERSECT. The Core Ultra 7 155H has a 28 W base / 115 W max turbo TDP. The Intel Arc A770 16GB launched at $349.
ISA extension for EPYC 9004 series, TDP for Xeon Platinum 8490H, launch price for Instinct MI300X.
EPYC 9004 (Genoa) supports AVX-512 including VNNI, BF16, VP2INTERSECT. The Instinct MI300X launched at ~$15,000–$20,000 estimated.
Sensor size of GFX 100 II, launch price of Hasselblad X2D 100C, TDP of M2 Ultra.
The Fujifilm GFX 100 II uses a 102 MP medium-format (43.8 × 32.9 mm) sensor. The Hasselblad X2D 100C launched at $8,199. The Apple M2 Ultra has a ~60 W sustained TDP in Mac Studio.
Sensor size of Phase One IQ4 150MP, launch price of Leica M11, TDP of Snapdragon 8cx Gen 3.
The Phase One IQ4 150MP uses a 151 MP medium-format (53.4 × 40.0 mm) CMOS. The Snapdragon 8cx Gen 3 has a ~9 W TDP in laptop designs.
